title: HOMONYM
summary: Words change worlds — a spoken and visual relay around 'LINE'. Construct a relay around one word with three visually legible senses. Establish its first use in an intact spoken context, let an action carry the next meaning before another voice names it, make the third sense alter the stakes, and return to the opening utterance. Cut across 8 verified public-domain archival windows (38.4s) and audited across two Critic Tribunal rounds (v1 → v2).

reviews.text:
VERDICT: repair_required (Round 1 — v1 assembly audit)
Critic Role: Independent inference critic

Observed Defects on v1 Proof Strip:
- Seg #03 (t=09.00s-14.80s): `12f71021` (`Freedom Seven`, 1961) cuts at 5.46s from the speakers to an aircraft carrier exterior.

Largest Gap:
The 5.8s duration on `12f71021` extended 0.54s past the internal cut at 5.46s.

Causal Hypothesis:
Clean window of `12f71021` is `0.05s-5.46s`; `in_s=0.2, dur=5.8` reached `6.0s`.

Falsifiable Repair Condition:
Clamp `12f71021` in Seg #03 and Seg #09 to `in_s=0.1, dur=5.1` so it stays completely inside `0.05s-5.46s` without ever cutting to the aircraft carrier.

Strength to Preserve:
The three-sense progression around 'LINE' (`f247b2aa` weather contour -> `12f71021` flight path line -> `aeebdc87` assembly line -> `7683b7a2`/`116af359` telephone line -> `74864d7a` hazard line -> `30fe8bbc` clothesline -> `12f71021` return).
